title: xdrip stopped working when I switched to 14 day libre
body:
I have been using xdrip with libre 10 day sensors and a blucon for over a year. My pharmacy informed me the 10 day sensor was no longer available. When I tried connecting using the libre 14 day sensor, the app found the blucon but did not collect any data. I purchased a new blucon from Ambrosia Systems. I connected the new blucon, and had the same result. The app finds the blucon but collects no data. I installed the blucon app to test the sensor and blucon, and it collected data. I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling Xdrip+ with no change. Any help resolving the issue would be appreciated.  
Thanks, Ed

comments.body:
This currently works with mm2 and bubble.
It might work in the future with blukon, but I don't know if and when.
According to miaomiao.cool libre 14 now works with xDrip +. However, it doesn't. The error in the log shows that it received more but than it expected. Can anyone tell me when this will be working?

> According to miaomiao.cool libre 14 now works with xDrip +. However, it doesn't. The error in the log shows that it received more but than it expected. Can anyone tell me when this will be working?

Not easy to get working (I'm on miaomiao 2 and libre14 with a Pixel 2 phone. You'll need the latest Alpha release, de-install Tomato and Glimp, and re-boot afterwards. I also had to play with the bluetooth settings (Settings / Less common settings / Bluetooth settings / Use scanning)

Took me an hour or so playing about to get it working - initially it connected ok and got data, then nothing - but all working now. Remeber to de-install the version of xDrip+ you have and go for the Alpha.

Right now it only works with the version that was published on the MM site.
Hopefully in a few days it will start working from the main xdrip releases.
@edjen54 Would you please close this issue if it has been resolved?
